# Hackathon Photos & Certificates

Place your files here following this structure:

hackathons/
  ibm/
    team.jpg          ← team photo
    moment.jpg        ← hackathon moment
    demo.jpg          ← project demo
    certificate.pdf   ← participation certificate
  kyndryl/
    team.jpg
    moment.jpg
    demo.jpg
    certificate.pdf
  hackhustle/
    team.jpg
    moment.jpg
    demo.jpg
    certificate.pdf

Files in public/ are served as static assets.
They will be available at: yoursite.com/hackathons/ibm/team.jpg
